title: Blob Royale protocol v3 HTTP error response
description: Current session failure envelope for representable errors on parsed /api/v3/ and retired /api/v2/ targets. Only grammar-valid retired routes receive SESSION_VERSION_UPGRADE_REQUIRED after global checks; earlier security failures retain their original code and precedence. v1 routes retain their immutable envelope. There is no in-band WebSocket error frame: a session failure is a close code.
